create_text_generation_pipeline: create a text generation pipeline using any causal language model for autoregressive text completion
complete_text_prompt: complete a text prompt by generating the next words using a causal language model with controlled sampling
generate_chat_responses: generate chat responses for conversational models by passing a list of role-content message dicts
return_only_new_text: return only the newly generated text instead of the full prompt plus generated text from the pipeline
handle_long_generation_hole: handle long generation exceeding model context by truncating the left side and leaving a gap for generation
